title: I love youu
description: This is me on a quiet evening. Soft white cap slightly tilted, long hair down, white tank top. I rested my hand under my chin and gave the camera a small, quiet smile. A tiny tattoo shows near my collarbone. No filters, no heavy makeup — just a simple, soft moment of me.
